what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Colombia in Germany: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4874 Colombian asylum seekers in Germany, 1.6% of all asylum seekers from Colombia.
Refugees from Colombia, a separate group, live mostly in Ecuador, Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1995 to 2025, with the ELN and FARC groups among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 81 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 6237, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Germany only.
